objective: Find a development-only mixture of negative-benefit, abstain, and positive-benefit history-correction contexts before training the counterfactual benefit router.
hypothesis: Distinct replay starts from the three development episodes contain at least two contexts in each signed-benefit class under the exact bounded scalar history-correction operator.
selection_reason: The prior supervision bank contained no negative-direction examples. Eight starts are frozen before execution to test whether this is a sampling limitation or a mechanism-level absence.
falsification_criterion: Reject data admission when fewer than two contexts pass the confidence lower-bound gate in any of the negative, abstain, or positive classes. Do not synthesize or relabel missing classes.
artifact_policy: Retain every context result, log, zero-dose video, input hash, merge receipt, atlas, selector, and failed class count. Never overwrite an existing output directory.

protocol.threshold_freeze_timing: Frozen before all eight context jobs launch.

probe_paths.transformation: apply fixed gain d through h_i'=h_i+d*(current-h_i) using the exact norm-bounded FSHC operator

data_admission_gate.fail_action: Do not train the multiscale candidate; return to context collection or mechanism redesign.

claim_scope: Development-only paired-dose class discovery. It is not repair-effect or promotion evidence.
